glosses: obsolete spelling of Völkerfrühling m (“Springtime of Nations”)

examples.text: Ein neuer Völkerfrüling bricht heran, es knospet allerorten und drängt zum neuen Leben fort durch die winterlichen Nebel hindurch einer mittelalterlichen Vergangenheit, deren Wesen und eigenthümliches, wenn auch einstmals zeitgemässes Gepräge wir bald nur noch aus der Geschichte kennen werden.
examples.translation: A new springtime of nations is dawning, buds are sprouting everywhere and pushing through the winter mists of a medieval past, whose essence and peculiar character, though once contemporary, will soon be known to us only from history.
examples.english: A new springtime of nations is dawning, buds are sprouting everywhere and pushing through the winter mists of a medieval past, whose essence and peculiar character, though once contemporary, will soon be known to us only from history.

examples.text: Nun blieb Kaiſer Friedrich durch zwei Menſchenalter der leꜩte Kaiſer des Abendlandes; auf ihn alſo ſchien ſich die alte morgenländiſche Prophezeiung zu beziehen; von ihm war die Wiederherſtellung der Herrlichkeit des Vaterlandes, von ihm der Errichtung des Gottesreiches, von ihm der ewige Völkerfrüling zu erwarten.
examples.translation: Now Emperor Frederick remained the last emperor of the West for two generations; the ancient Eastern prophecy seemed to refer to him; from him was to be expected the restoration of the glory of the fatherland, from him the establishment of the kingdom of God, from him the eternal springtime of peoples.
examples.english: Now Emperor Frederick remained the last emperor of the West for two generations; the ancient Eastern prophecy seemed to refer to him; from him was to be expected the restoration of the glory of the fatherland, from him the establishment of the kingdom of God, from him the eternal springtime of peoples.
